Enum Class SshSessionMode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SshSessionMode>
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshSessionMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SshSessionMode>, Constable
public enum SshSessionMode extends Enum<SshSessionMode>
The SshSessionMode type names the remote terminal request for one SSH session. The name SSH means the secure shell this client opens. The VT100 constant names the remote type vt100. The PTY constant names the remote type xterm-256color. The pseudoterminal is the remote terminal the server allocates for the shell. The name JediTerm means the terminal widget that draws the session on this computer. The JediTerm widget stays the local emulator. The type does not change that widget. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshSessionMode

  • Enum Constant Details

    • VT100

      public static final SshSessionMode VT100
      The VT100 constant is the default remote terminal request. The stored token is vt100. The label in the mode combo, the control that lists these modes, is VT100. The remote terminal type is vt100.

    • PTY

      public static final SshSessionMode PTY
      The PTY constant is the standard remote terminal request. The name PTY means a pseudoterminal, the remote terminal the server allocates. The stored token is pty. The label in the mode combo is Standard PTY. The remote terminal type is xterm-256color.

    • getDisplayName

      public String getDisplayName()
      The getDisplayName method returns the label shown in the mode combo. The mode combo is the control that lists these modes.
      Returns:
      The return value is VT100 or Standard PTY.

    • getTermType

      public String getTermType()
      The getTermType method returns the terminal type requested of the server. The value is the TERM string on the remote pseudoterminal, the terminal the server allocates. The method returns xterm-256color when this mode is PTY. The method returns vt100 for every other mode.
      Returns:
      The return value is vt100 or xterm-256color.

    • fromPropertyValue

      public static SshSessionMode fromPropertyValue(String value)
      The fromPropertyValue method reads a stored token back into a mode. The comparison ignores letter case. The method returns VT100 when the token is null. The method returns VT100 when the token matches no mode.
      Parameters:
      value - The token from the properties file. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the matching mode. The value is never null.
